findings.title: Cleartext plugin reads STORE4A_API_BASE directly instead of the resolved API_BASE
findings.detail: The plugin now gates on process.env.STORE4A_API_BASE || '' while app.config.ts computes API_BASE with an https:// default. The behavior is equivalent (the default fallback can never be http://, and an explicit http:// value triggers cleartext in both), so Android cleartext behavior is preserved. Noting only because the two files now derive the http:// test from slightly different expressions; a shared helper would prevent future drift.

findings.title: social-login has no unit/runtime smoke test
findings.detail: api-node has no unit-test runner (build/tsc is the gate per context.json), so the 401/400/422 branches and the P2002 retry loop are verified by code review and a clean tsc build only, not by an executed request. Acceptable under the task's stated verification model; a future runtime smoke test against a dev DB would harden it.
